name: LifeLine
description: Life Line is a full-fledged web-based platform designed to manage and automate the blood donation process. It bridges the gap between donors, recipients, and hospitals through a centralized online system, enabling real-time emergency blood request handling, smart donor matching, and inventory management accessible from anywhere. With its browser-based interface and cloud-backed architecture, Life Line ensures fast, secure, and seamless coordination among all stakeholders.
